reviews.name: T.L
reviews.body: I love using these toner pads as a quick 5 to 10-minute mask before applying makeup, depending on how my skin feels that day. It prepares my skin so well and makes my makeup go on smoothly!

reviews.name: Emma
reviews.body: Sadly, these toner pads are worth it. I personally prefer the blue hydrating version more than these one, but they are still a solid choice. I leave the toner pads on for 20 minutes and they leave my skin calm and happy. I am a complete convert for toner pads. Huge difference to my skin.
Love the bio dance refreshing sea kelp face pads !!
